name: Group Spectate
description: Spectate a group centered on the mean position of its riders. Ctrl+click a rider-list group header or pick a live <25m pack from the Group Cam pill.

settings.label: Camera distance mode
settings.description: fixed = keep Biketerra's current camera distance; auto = pull back automatically as the group spreads.

settings.label: Group tracking mode
settings.description: cluster = dynamically follow the <25m pack (drops riders who fall behind, includes joiners); dom = follow only riders from the clicked group while grouped.

settings.label: Cluster radius (m)
settings.description: Distance threshold in meters for auto-detecting groups and dynamic cluster tracking.

settings.label: Auto pull-back factor
settings.description: How far to pull the camera back per meter of group radius in auto mode.

settings.label: Center smoothing (0.02 - 1.0)
settings.description: EMA smoothing factor per frame for group center & pull-back (lower = smoother, 1 = instant).
